2116999834003722667.en_summary: Doug Kass criticizes short-term market calls, noting Tom Lee of Fundstrat changed his bottom call three times in a week (now 'between now and midterms'). Quotes Warren Buffett that stock forecasters make fortune tellers look good and nobody knows what the market will do tomorrow, next week or next month. Questions CNBC on Lee's errant predictions on crypto and equities. Quoted post has Tom Lee calling AI sell-off a coiled spring, citing Cisco's 50% drawdown in 1997 from 5 to 18 a year later, and that ChatGPT is early in AI trade.
2116999834003722667.zh_summary: Doug Kass 批評短期市場預測，指出 Fundstrat 的 Tom Lee 一週內三次更改其底部預測（現為「從現在到中期選舉之間」）。引用 Warren Buffett 稱股票預測者讓算命師顯得專業，沒人知道市場明天、下週或下個月會如何。質疑 CNBC 對 Lee 在加密貨幣和股票上的錯誤預測。引用帖中 Tom Lee 稱 AI 拋售為蓄勢待發的彈簧，提及 1997 年 Cisco 從高點下跌 50% 至 5，一年後升至 18，並表示 ChatGPT 在 AI 交易中仍屬早期。
